messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand your concern about changing settings. The MMSC URL is essential for sending and receiving MMS messages—it's the server address your phone uses to handle picture/video messages. Since it's not set, that's why your MMS isn't working.

The safe solution is to reset your APN settings to the default carrier settings, which will restore the correct MMSC URL. This is a standard troubleshooting step and won't erase your personal data.

Please run **reset_apn_settings()** on your phone to restore the default APN settings.

After you've reset the APN settings, you must reboot your device for the changes to take effect. Please run **reboot_device()** next.

Once your phone has restarted, let me know and we'll test your MMS functionality.

I have reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. The status bar still shows an excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled. What should I do now to check if the MMS message can be sent?

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
